Dave Matthews Band 
June 23 , 2012 
Klipsch Music Center (Deer Creek) 
Noblesville, IN 



Taper: Rockinman 
Location: Behind soundboard, DFC, mics DINA 90 config, stand height @ 14 feet 
Source: akg460mods/ck63 hypercaps(linear bass setting)>UA5 preamp(Wmod)>Marantz PMD661(SPDIF In) @ 24/48 kHz 
Transfer: PMD661->USB->PC 
Conversion: 24/48kHz wav->Sound Forge Pro 10> iZotope 64-Bit SRC & iZotope MBIT+ for resample and  dither to 16/44.1 kHz,No normalization, Waves L3 UltraMaximizer and fade in and fade out applied->CDWave Editor->Flac Frontend(level 5)> Foobar 2000 for tagging

***** DO NOT ENCODE THIS SHOW TO LOSSY FORMATS EXCEPT FOR PERSONAL USE*** 
******************DO NOT SELL OR DISTRIBUTE FOR PROFIT******************* 
*************************************************************************
